verdict.rationale: Docs confirm SES supports domain-level identity verification (eliminating per-address verification) and a setup flow for verifying a sending domain, implying DNS-based verification, but the evidence never explicitly describes generating SPF/DKIM/DMARC records or exposing verification status via API. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic SPF/DKIM/DMARC record generation, DKIM signing setup (Easy DKIM), and API endpoints/fields for checking verification status.
